detect_points.label: Detect points
detect_points.description: Return a JSON array of 2D points anchored to detected objects. Coordinates are normalized to 0-1000 to match Gemini Robotics ER's point format.
detect_points.default_prompt_template: Detect {target} in the image. Return a JSON array of objects of the form {{"point": [y, x], "label": "<name>"}} where each point is in {point_format}. Only output the JSON array.

per_model_prompt_templates.molmo: Point to the {target} in the image.

detect_boxes.label: Detect bounding boxes
detect_boxes.description: Return a JSON array of axis-aligned bounding boxes. Coordinates are `[ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]` normalized to 0-1000.
detect_boxes.default_prompt_template: Return bounding boxes as a JSON array with labels. Never return masks or code fencing. Limit to 25 objects. Detect {target}. If an object is present multiple times, name them according to their unique characteristic (colors, size, position, unique characteristics, etc.). The format should be as follows: [{{"box_2d": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], "label": "<label for the object>"}}] normalized to 0-1000. The values in box_2d must only be integers.

segment.label: Segment
segment.description: Return per-object segmentation masks. Each item carries a `box_2d` region and a base64-encoded PNG `mask` that fills it.

mask.description: Base64 PNG (may be prefixed with `data:image/png;base64,`). Luminance of the PNG defines the silhouette within `box_2d`.

segment.default_prompt_template: Segment {target} in the image. Return a JSON array of objects of the form {{"mask": "<base64 PNG>", "box_2d": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], "label": "<name>"}}. Only output the JSON array.

point_trajectory.label: Predict image-plane trajectory
point_trajectory.description: Return an ordered JSON array of 2D points forming a trajectory (start → end) in image coordinates. Shape matches ``detect_points`` so it can be rendered with the same overlay; array order encodes the sequence (index = waypoint number). Matches Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6's native trajectory contract: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/robotics-overview

label.description: Ordinal index as a string ('0', '1', ...). The array position is the source of truth; the label is a display hint.

point_trajectory.default_prompt_template: Predict a trajectory for completing: {target}. Return an ordered JSON array of waypoints of the form {{"point": [y, x], "label": "<index>"}} where each point is in {point_format} and the array order is the time order of the trajectory (index 0 is the start, index n-1 is the end). Aim for 4-12 waypoints. Only output the JSON array.

per_model_prompt_templates.molmo: Point at each step of the trajectory for: {target}. Start from the beginning and emit 4-12 consecutive points.
